sentences.zh: 联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米与国家安全局局长迈克尔·罗杰斯一同坐在华盛顿一间听证会室内一张长长的木桌后面。

sentences.en: The Department of Justice has asked me to share with you that the answer is the same for the Department of Justice and all its components.

sentences.en: This was like nothing else we've seen.

sentences.en: But he says that in some cases, the public need to know is so important that it kind of supersedes the normal secrecy rules.

sentences.zh: 我们将成为一个强大、自主、全球化的英国，重新掌控我们的边境和法律。

sentences.en: The process, led by Prime Minister Theresa May, is expected to take at least two years.
sentences.zh: 这一由首相特雷莎·梅领导的进程预计将至少耗时两年。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.en: I was disc at north of the house trying to get a fire guard, and I had less than three minutes.
sentences.zh: 我在房子北面试图找一个防火挡板，当时我的时间不到三分钟。

sentences.en: That wind was blowing probably 60 or more.
sentences.zh: 那风速大概有60英里或更快。

sentences.en: Our wildfires in the American West have killed seven people and thousands of cattle, and scorched hundreds of thousands of acres of land, from Kansas to Colorado.
sentences.zh: 美国西部的野火已经夺去了七人的生命和数千头牛的性命，并从堪萨斯州一直到科罗拉多州，烧毁了数十万英亩的土地。

sentences.en: Got in my pickup and was able to get out of there.
sentences.zh: 我上了皮卡车，总算逃了出来。

sentences.en: And just that quick, everything is engulfed.
sentences.zh: 就在那一瞬间，一切都被大火吞噬了。

sentences.en: Weeks without snow or rain, and late winter temperatures reaching 80 degrees, are threatening to create more fires in the days ahead.
sentences.zh: 数周没有降雪或降雨，加之冬末气温高达80华氏度，正威胁着在未来几天引发更多火灾。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日晨报》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。
